title: Cathedral of Static
style: post-rock, cinematic, slow build, tremolo guitars, swelling strings, no vocal until bridge, distant male choir, huge crescendo, epic
lyrics:
[Intro - Instrumental]
(soft tremolo guitar, distant strings)

[Build]
(drums enter slowly, layered arpeggios)

[Bridge - first vocal entry, distant male choir]
We are the chapel
We are the noise
Every cathedral
Is built on a voice

We are the static
We are the prayer
Light in the rafters
Of nobody's air

[Crescendo]
(full band, choir swells, drums thunder)
Louder, louder
Louder than fear
Louder, louder
We are still here

[Outro]
(strings hold, slow decay into reverb)
